analysis:
This PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md: it bumps the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and expands the forced tool_choice documentation (head lines 2016-2040). No executable code, key handling, attestation, cache storage or authorization paths are modified, so there is no direct security regression.

The new text documents that the coordinator routes required/named tool_choice requests only to builds listed in `tool_constraint_models` (filled by `ToolChoiceEnforcementPolicy.advertisesCapability`). Forced calls are withheld and schema-validated (`.structuredPostValidation`). `NativeToolStreamRouter` drops only ASCII framing whitespace, whitespace alone counts as a missing call, and any other visible text is a 422 violation. This is a conservative, fail-closed description. It relates to TB-002 (coordinator-to-provider routing gate) and T-009 (private-request routing). Output correctness remains unproven by the provider (T-007, T-056).

Units 13 and 14 are unchanged context: prefix-cache, SSD staging, MTP and deadline admission. T-041 (cache oracle and SSD at-rest posture) is not altered, and the documented cache scoping and 30-minute TTL behavior was not touched here.

Not verified: the doc's claims about the enforcing code (`advertisesCapability`, `structuredForcedToolModelTypes`, `isFramingWhitespace`, `ToolConstraintValidation.validate`) cannot be checked here, since the source is not in this batch. If the code changes accompanying this doc (for example the MiMo and Qwen builds added to the forced-tool list) are in other batches, they should be reviewed for the routing gate and for the whitespace-stripping parser behavior. Docs-only here, so no findings.
